# v1.9.2 — Edit Nabava items after creation

- Added in-place editing for Nabava item text in the global list and board To-Do panel on web and mobile.
- Web item titles open an edit prompt; cancel/Esc leaves the stored text unchanged.
- Mobile rows provide an edit pencil and tap-to-edit behavior; board-origin items use the board route and manual entries use the global Nabava route.
- Existing backend PATCH routes are reused; edits broadcast Nabava/board sync events so other clients refresh.

## Verification

- Browser checks verified all three edit paths and their API routes; Flutter 3.24.3 analysis and all 7 Flutter tests passed.
- Mobile package version: **1.9.2+8**.
